modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mtrlte: LTY's Transit Expansion Decoration (LTED) is a decoration add-on for Minecraft Transit Railway: Xiamen-style platform screen doors and platform blocks, two PIDS variants (metro and BRT), PSD-LCD hanging boards, wall and ceiling departure countdowns, station signage, clocks, ticket machines, gates, security scanners, power-bank and drinks machines, RCC platform blocks, Xiamen, Nanputuo and Jiaomei decoration props, and a ported Fangsu platform screen door set.
opt.pids_ad_set.empty: Global ad set: ON but empty (no effect yet)

opt.xpids.arriving.on: Arriving: ON ("arriving" within the last minute)

reset.confirm.global: Every global value goes back to its default, and all per-siding overrides are cleared (sidings follow the globals again). Nothing is written to disk until you press Done; Cancel undoes it.
reset.confirm.siding: Every override for this siding is deleted, so all of its parameters follow the globals again (this is not "copy the global defaults in"). Nothing is written until Save & back; Back undoes it.
reset.confirm.title: Reset to defaults?
